title: Modernize VB6 Forms to C#
problem_statement: Legacy VB6 forms need to be rewritten in C# to support modern development practices.
risk_if_unaddressed: Continued use of outdated and unsupported technology.
suggested_approach: Rewrite each form using C# WinForms or WPF, ensuring compatibility with the existing business logic.
success_criteria: All forms function as expected in the C# environment.
No loss of functionality from the original VB6 application.
